# n8n - Secure Workflow Automation for Technical Teams

n8n is a workflow automation platform that gives technical teams the flexibility of code with the speed of no-code. With 400+ integrations, native AI capabilities, and a fair-code license, n8n lets you build powerful automations while maintaining full control over your data and deployments.

script.hook: Empower your workflow with n8n: AI-driven automation that's fair-code and packed with power.
script.body: Imagine a platform where you can visually build complex workflows, then add custom code for the edge cases. With over 400 integrations out of the box and native AI capabilities, n8n gives you the flexibility to self-host or use cloud services. It's not just automation; it’s revolutionizing how we approach work.
